title: Golaghat
sub: From Assampedia, the free Assam encyclopedia
body:
Golaghat is a town and district in Upper Assam, on the Dhansiri river, between Jorhat and the Karbi hills. It is a tea-growing district with many gardens.

Kaziranga link

Golaghat district includes the southern side of Kaziranga National Park, and the town is a base for visitors to the park's Kohora range.

History

The district has Ahom-era sites, including the Negheriting Shiva temple, and was historically a centre of the region's tea and timber trade.
